# ggicons

The ggicons package allows you to visualise data with icons in ggplot2.
It uses icons from the
[icons](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/icons/)
package as the `icon` aesthetic in
[`geom_icon()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/geom_icon.md).

## Installation

You can install the **development** version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mitchelloharawild/ggicons)

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mitchelloharawild/ggicons")
```

# Package index

## Geom

Draw icons in place of points.

- [`geom_icon()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/geom_icon.md)
  : Icons

## Scales

Map icon data to the `icon` aesthetic.

- [`scale_icon_identity()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/scale_icon_identity.md)
  : Use icon values as-is
- [`scale_icon_manual()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/scale_icon_manual.md)
  : Map discrete values to icons manually

## Legend key

Draw icons in legend keys.

- [`draw_key_icon()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/draw_key_icon.md)
  : Legend key glyph: an icon

## Annotations

Add a fixed-position icon to a plot.

- [`annotation_icon()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/annotation_icon.md)
  : Annotate a plot with icons at fixed positions

## Theme

Draw axis, strip and legend labels as icons.

- [`element_icon()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/ggicons/reference/element_icon.md)
  : Theme element: draw labels as icons
